verdict.rationale: New Relic ships vendor-maintained language agents (Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, Ruby), dedicated infrastructure monitoring for hosts/containers/providers/network, Kubernetes cost/visibility integration, AWS Lambda serverless instrumentation, OpenTelemetry support, and Terraform-based agent fleet management at scale — covering the full breadth of hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services the story asks for. Community feedback shows some real-world friction (a logging-agent bug that lost data, 'in-cluster collection services are frustratingly fragile') indicating occasional reliability issues but not a documented failure of the core instrumentation capability itself. missing for 10: independent benchmarking of integration breadth/quality across all cloud providers, and stronger resolution of the community-reported fragility of in-cluster/Kubernetes collectors.
